title: "Immcantation - enchantR"

params:
   input:
      label: "`input`: Path to the annotated repertoire (AIRR tsv)"
      input: file
      value: "input.tsv"
   outname:
      label: "`outname`: Output file prefix"
      input: text
      value: "sample"
   locus:
      label: "`locus`: the receptor class (`IG`, `TR`) or the loci (e.g. `IGH`, or `IGH,IGK`) the samples target. Comma-separated."
      input: text
      value: "IG"
   restrict_to_locus:
      label: "`restrict_to_locus`: Drop sequences whose locus is not one of `locus`."
      input: checkbox
      value: FALSE
   skip_alignment_filter:
      label: "`skip_alignment_filter`: Skip the V/D/J call, locus, N and length filters."
      input: checkbox
      value: FALSE
   max_n_fraction:
      label: "`max_n_fraction`: Maximum fraction of N among aligned positions."
      input: numeric
      value: 0.1
   min_informative_length:
      label: "`min_informative_length`: Minimum number of aligned positions that are not N or gaps."
      input: numeric
      value: 200
   productive_only:
      label: "`productive_only`: Keep productive sequences with a junction length that is a multiple of 3."
      input: checkbox
      value: TRUE
   log:
      label: "`log`"
      input: text
      value: "command_log"
   outdir:
      label: '`outdir`: Output directory'
      input: text
      value: !r file.path(getwd(),'enchantr')
   date:
      label: '`date`: Run date'
      input: date
      value: !r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d")
   logo:
      label: "`logo`: Path to report logo"
      input: file
      value: !r file.path("assets", "logo.png")
   logolink:
      label: "`logolink`: URL to be added to the logo"
      input: text
      value: "immcantation.org"
   echo:
      label: '`echo`: Show code in the report.'
      input: checkbox
      value: TRUE
   cache:
      label: '`cache`: Use cached results'
      input: checkbox
      value: FALSE
editor_options:
   chunk_output_type: console

```{r global-options, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=7, fig.height=4, fig.path = "figures/",
                     echo=params$echo,cache=params$cache,
                     warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,
                     eval.after="fig.cap",
                     out_dir=params$outdir,
                     eval.opts = c('eval', 'echo', 'fig.height', 'fig.width'))

# Libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("enchantr"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("dplyr"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("airr"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("alakazam"))

if (!dir.exists(params[['outdir']])) {
   dir.create(params[['outdir']], recursive = T)
}

file.copy(params$logo,
         file.path(params$outdir,"assets", "logo.png"),
         recursive = T, overwrite=T)
```

# Input parameters

```{r input-parameters, results='asis'}
printParams(params)
```
```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
print_table_caption(tag="input", text="Input parameters.")
save(params, file=file.path(params$outdir,"params.RData"))
```

# Read repertoire

```{r read, results="asis"}
db <- read_rearrangement(params$input)
input_size <- nrow(db)
locus_in <- if ("locus" %in% colnames(db)) db[["locus"]] else getLocus(db[["v_call"]])
productive_fail <- NULL

cat(paste("The repertoire has", input_size, "sequences."))
```

# Filtration

The filters below are applied in order, to the sequences left by the previous one.
Checked filters were applied; the parameter that turns each one on or off is in brackets.

```{r filter-list, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
alignment <- !as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter)
productive <- as.logical(params$productive_only)
filters <- data.frame(
    filter = c("Remove sequences without a V call (`skip_alignment_filter`)",
               "Remove sequences whose V call disagrees with the locus (`skip_alignment_filter`, needs a `locus` column)",
               paste0("Remove sequences with more than ", params$max_n_fraction * 100, "% N (`skip_alignment_filter`)"),
               paste0("Remove sequences shorter than ", params$min_informative_length,
                      " informative positions (`skip_alignment_filter`)"),
               paste0("Keep the targeted loci, ", params$locus, " (`restrict_to_locus`)"),
               "Keep productive sequences (`productive_only`)",
               "Remove sequences with a junction length not a multiple of 3 (`productive_only`)"),
    applied = c(alignment, alignment && "locus" %in% colnames(db), alignment, alignment,
                as.logical(params$restrict_to_locus), productive, productive))
cat(paste0("- [", ifelse(filters$applied, "x", " "), "] ", filters$filter, "\n"), sep = "")
```

```{r eval=!as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter), results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("
## Remove sequences without a V call

The aligner reports a row for every sequence it was given, including those it could not
assign to a V gene. Without a V call a sequence has no locus to check, and the steps
that follow (germline reconstruction, clonal assignment, genotyping) cannot use it, so
it is removed. This includes sequences with no gene call at all.
")
```

```{r has-v-call, eval=!as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter), results="asis"}
before_filter_nrow <- nrow(db)
db <- db %>% filter(!is.na(v_call))
cat(paste(before_filter_nrow - nrow(db), "sequences without a V call were removed."))
```

```{r eval=!as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter) && "locus" %in% colnames(db), results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("
## Remove sequences whose V call disagrees with the locus

The `locus` field reported by the aligner should be the locus of the V gene called.
A sequence where the two disagree has an unreliable assignment and is removed.
")
```

```{r same-locus, eval=!as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter) && "locus" %in% colnames(db), results="asis"}
before_filter_nrow <- nrow(db)
db <- db %>% filter(getLocus(v_call) == locus)
cat(paste(before_filter_nrow - nrow(db), "sequences whose V call is from another locus were removed."))
```

```{r eval=!as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter), results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat(paste0("
## Remove sequences with too many N

Sequences in which more than ", params$max_n_fraction * 100, "% of the aligned
positions (`sequence_alignment` without gaps) are N are removed.
"))
```

```{r low-n, eval=!as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter), results="asis"}
before_filter_nrow <- nrow(db)
db <- db %>% filter(nchar(gsub("[^Nn]", "", sequence_alignment)) <=
                        params$max_n_fraction * nchar(gsub("[-.]", "", sequence_alignment)))
cat(paste0(before_filter_nrow - nrow(db), " sequences with more than ",
           params$max_n_fraction * 100, "% N were removed."))
```

```{r eval=!as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter), results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat(paste0("
## Remove short sequences

Sequences with fewer than ", params$min_informative_length, " informative positions in
`sequence_alignment` (not N, `-` or `.`) are removed.
"))
```

```{r long-seq, eval=!as.logical(params$skip_alignment_filter), results="asis"}
before_filter_nrow <- nrow(db)
db <- db %>% filter(nchar(gsub("[-.Nn]", "", sequence_alignment)) >= params$min_informative_length)
cat(paste(before_filter_nrow - nrow(db), "sequences shorter than",
          params$min_informative_length, "informative positions were removed."))
```

```{r fill-locus, echo=FALSE}
if (!"locus" %in% colnames(db)) {
    db[["locus"]] <- getLocus(db[["v_call"]])
}
```

```{r eval=as.logical(params$restrict_to_locus), results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat(paste0("
## Keep the targeted loci

A library that targets one locus can still contain sequences assigned to another: the
aligner reports the best match in the reference it was given. The targeted loci are
**", params$locus, "**; sequences of any other locus are removed. The table shows the
sequences of each locus found in the data, and how many are retained.
"))
```

```{r restrict-locus, eval=as.logical(params$restrict_to_locus), results="asis"}
before_filter_nrow <- nrow(db)
locus_filter <- count(db, locus, name = "sequences")
db <- db %>% filter(locus_matches(locus, params$locus))
locus_filter <- locus_filter %>%
    left_join(count(db, locus, name = "retained"), by = "locus") %>%
    mutate(retained = coalesce(retained, 0L),
           targeted = locus_matches(locus, params$locus))

caption_text <- paste0("Sequences per locus before and after keeping the targeted loci (",
                       params$locus, "). ", before_filter_nrow - nrow(db),
                       " sequences outside the targeted loci were removed.")
tab <- eetable(locus_filter, caption = caption_text,
               outdir = params$outdir, file = "locus_filter")
tab$table
```

```{r eval=as.logical(params$restrict_to_locus), echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
print_table_caption(tag = "locus_filter", text = caption_text)
```

```{r eval=as.logical(params$productive_only), results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("
## Keep productive sequences

Sequences the aligner calls non-productive (a stop codon, or V and J out of frame) are
removed.

## Remove sequences with a junction length not a multiple of 3

A productive sequence can still have a junction whose length is not a multiple of 3.
These are removed.

The sequences removed by both filters, and those with no `productive` or
`junction_length` value, are saved together in a separate file, listed under Output.
")
```

```{r productive, eval=as.logical(params$productive_only), results="asis"}
before_filter_nrow <- nrow(db)
productive_fail <- db %>% filter(!(as.logical(productive) %in% TRUE))
db <- db %>% filter(as.logical(productive))
cat(paste(before_filter_nrow - nrow(db), "non-productive sequences were removed. "))

before_filter_nrow <- nrow(db)
productive_fail <- bind_rows(productive_fail, db %>% filter(!((junction_length %% 3 == 0) %in% TRUE)))
db <- db %>% filter(junction_length %% 3 == 0)
cat(paste(before_filter_nrow - nrow(db), "sequences with a junction length not a multiple of 3 were removed."))
```

# Summary

```{r locus-counts, results="asis"}
locus_summary <- full_join(
    count(data.frame(locus = locus_in), locus, name = "input"),
    count(data.frame(locus = db[["locus"]]), locus, name = "output"),
    by = "locus") %>%
    mutate(across(c(input, output), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)))

caption_text <- paste("Number of sequences per locus before and after filtration.",
                      nrow(db), "of", input_size, "sequences passed. Targeted:", params$locus)
tab <- eetable(locus_summary, caption = caption_text,
               outdir = params$outdir, file = "locus_summary")
tab$table
```

```{r echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
print_table_caption(tag = "locus_summary", text = caption_text)
```

# Output

```{r output, results="asis"}
dir.create(file.path(params$outdir, "repertoires"), showWarnings = FALSE)
output_fn <- file.path(params$outdir, "repertoires", paste0(params$outname, "_qc-pass.tsv"))
write_rearrangement(db, file = output_fn)
cat("- [", basename(output_fn), "](", file.path("repertoires", basename(output_fn)), ")\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(productive_fail)) {
    productive_fail_fn <- file.path(params$outdir, "repertoires", paste0(params$outname, "_productive-fail.tsv"))
    write_rearrangement(productive_fail, file = productive_fail_fn)
    cat("- [", basename(productive_fail_fn), "](", file.path("repertoires", basename(productive_fail_fn)), ")\n", sep = "")
}

log_fn <- paste0(params$log, ".txt")
cat("START> AnnotationQC", file = log_fn, append = F)
cat(paste0("\nFILE> ", basename(params$input)), file = log_fn, append = T)
cat(paste0("\nOUTPUT> ", basename(output_fn)), file = log_fn, append = T)
cat(paste0("\nPASS> ", nrow(db)), file = log_fn, append = T)
cat(paste0("\nFAIL> ", input_size - nrow(db)), file = log_fn, append = T)
```
